svg.title: Kelp Apothecary — Kelp drying terraces
svg.desc: Kelp racks rise through three sheltered terraces to a mixing room. Mortar tables, crate steps and drying beams offer low hops beside proper stairs. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
